notes.title: Karma on iOS!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9835858/c167853b75bb5db9f43b43170ba0ce0d60ce2bab.gif

Great news again!

Our psychedelic point-and-click adventure game "Karma. Incarnation 1"  is now available on iOS:  
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/karma-incarnation-1/id1214318649?l=en&ls=1&mt=8

If you like Karma, you'll definitely want a free pack of deliciously bizarre iMessage stickers featuring characters from the game =) 
This is our humble gift to all of you. Thanks for your support! 
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/karma-incarnation-1-bizarre-stickers/id1270075477?l=en&ls=1&mt=8

On iTunes, you can also find the magical original game soundtrack by ZMEIRADUGA. Have fun =)
